|game_text='''0 side — On The Verge Of Greatness'''

Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships. Once per turn, may deploy a Scarif battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your non-unique Imperials, vehicles, and capital starships are deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer). Non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site and Death Star orbiting Scarif.

'''7 side — Taking Control Of The Weapon'''

While this side up, A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's Force drain modifiers everywhere. Vader may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. At Death Star, system it orbits, and sites related to either, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if your non-unique card with ability in battle). During your draw phase, may retrieve a non-unique card with ability. Flip this card if you do not have a leader at a Scarif battleground site. Place out of play if Death Star or Shield Gate not on table.

|rulings=* (0-side) In the deploy -1/-2 sentence, the words 'non-unique' apply to Imperials, vehicles, capital starships, and Star Destroyers.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=On%20The%20Verge%20Of%20Greatness%20/%20Taking%20Control%20Of%20The%20Weapon Scomp: On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* (7-side) [[A Bright Center To The Universe]] is expanded from the target system to all locations, but still only applies to Force drain modifiers that come from Light's cards affecting Light's Force drains. See that card for further rulings.
* (7-side) [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] can make any type of regular move into battle. Examples include landspeed, shuttling (up or down) and docking bay transit.
* (7-side) The 'move to a battle' text does ''not'' permit an unlimited move, (e.g. it does not allow [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] to disembark [[Blizzard 4]]).
* (7-side) [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] can make one regular move on each turn (including Light's turn), whether the regular move is via this card or not.
* (7-side) If [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] has already battled this turn, he can still make a regular move to a battle, but will not participate in that second battle.
* (7-side) [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] cannot use the text on [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s Castle to move into battle, nor any other site that specifies that it only works during move phase.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon]] (version 3 of 3). The image here is the current Players Committee card images (both sides published 9 March 2026, marked E1). This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' ([[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon]]): Virtual Set 16 release; both card images first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="img-o-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “On The Verge Of Greatness: Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, Commence Primary Ignition, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy characters of ability > 4 (except Vader). Vader is power +2 and he (or a Star Destroyer he is piloting) may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy a site (or Imperial trooper) to Scarif from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin on Scarif and Death Star orbiting Scarif. Taking Control Of The Weapon: While this side up, your Force generation is +2 for each 'blown away' Scarif site. Tarkin Doctrine is immune to Alter and, when it initiates Force loss, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile. Once per turn, if opponent's character just lost from your site, may place it out of play unless opponent loses 1 Force. Tarkin adds 3 to total of Commence Primary Ignition. Flip this card if you have no leaders on Scarif. Place this card out of play if Shield Gate not on table or if Death Star has been 'blown away.'” No E mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon (Errata)]]): PC re-rendering of the Virtual Set 16 images; both card images published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="img-PC-E1-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “On The Verge Of Greatness: Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, Commence Primary Ignition, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy characters of ability > 4 (except Vader). Vader is power +2 and he (or a Star Destroyer he is piloting) may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy a site (or Imperial trooper) to Scarif from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin on Scarif and Death Star orbiting Scarif. Taking Control Of The Weapon: While this side up, your Force generation is +2 for each 'blown away' Scarif site. Tarkin Doctrine is immune to Alter and, when it initiates Force loss, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile. Once per turn, if opponent's character just lost from your site, may place it out of play unless opponent loses 1 Force. Tarkin adds 3 to total of Commence Primary Ignition. Flip this card if you have no leaders on Scarif. Place this card out of play if Shield Gate not on table or if Death Star has been 'blown away.'” No E mark. The PC published pixel-identical copies on 5 July 2022 (format change only). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the images only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC errata of 9 March 2026; both card images marked E1 published 9 March 2026, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="img-PC-E2-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “On The Verge Of Greatness: Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships. Once per turn, may deploy a Scarif battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your non-unique Imperials, vehicles, and capital starships are deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer). Non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site and Death Star orbiting Scarif. Taking Control Of The Weapon: While this side up, A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's Force drain modifiers everywhere. Vader may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. At Death Star, system it orbits, and sites related to either, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if your non-unique card with ability in battle). During your draw phase, may retrieve a non-unique card with ability. Flip this card if you do not have a leader at a Scarif battleground site. Place out of play if Death Star or Shield Gate not on table.” The card prints E1; this is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. The printed mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). The PC card data's errata note (9 March 2026) quotes the previous 0-side text. '''What changed:''' Both sides were rewritten. 0 side: “Commence Primary Ignition” was dropped from the deploy list; the restriction “characters of ability > 4 (except Vader)” and the Vader bonus were replaced by “you may not deploy Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships”; the once-per-turn deploy now takes a Scarif battleground (any time, not only while this side up); non-unique Imperials, vehicles and capital starships deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer) and non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1; the flip needs Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site. 7 side: the whole text was replaced (A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's drain modifiers; Vader may move to a battle just initiated; battle destiny +1 (+2) at Death Star and related locations; draw-phase retrieval of a non-unique card with ability; new flip and out-of-play conditions). Both sides gained the E1 mark.
